story_log.title: Knicks take 3-0 stranglehold on Cavs with dominant road win, one win from Finals
story_log.development: New York won Game 3 in Cleveland 121-108 to take commanding 3-0 series lead. Brunson had 35-3, Mikal Bridges 22-6, OG 21-7. Knicks have won 10 straight playoff games, largest postseason point differential since 1970 (+234). No team has ever come back from 0-3. Knicks one win from first Finals since 1999.

story_log.title: Canadiens tie series 1-1 after Ehlers' OT winner stuns Hurricanes at home
story_log.development: Montreal won Game 2 in Raleigh 3-2 in OT. Nikolaj Ehlers scored twice including OT winner to even series. Carolina had taken Game 1 by 6-2 margin but Habs bounce back to tie it up. Series shifts to Montreal for Game 3.

story_log.title: Scott Foster named crew chief for Thunder-Spurs Game 4 after OKC takes 2-1 lead
story_log.development: NBA activated 'Series Extender' protocol: Scott Foster will officiate Thunder-Spurs Game 4 on Sunday with OKC leading 2-1. Internet immediately reacts to Foster assignment, expecting Game 4 to go San Antonio's way. The NBA's most notorious referee gets the call.

story_log.title: Abdul Carter clears air with Jaxson Dart after QB introduced Trump at rally
story_log.development: Giants QB Jaxson Dart introduced President Trump at rally, drawing criticism. Teammate Abdul Carter initially sacked him publicly on social media. Both later said they're 'good' and 'spoke as men.' John Harbaugh (per BallsackSports satire) says Carter needs to apologize to locker room. Internet jokes Giants season over before it started. Drama in year one of Harbaugh era.

story_log.title: Lance Stephenson submits Michael Beasley in first round of MMA fight
story_log.development: Two former NBA teammates faced off in MMA fight. Lance submitted Beasley seconds into first round with rear naked choke. This came after Beasley beat Lance in 2025 TNC 1-on-1 basketball PPV for $100k. Their rivalry now spans basketball, 1v1 battles, and MMA.

story_log.title: Johnny Manziel knocks out Bob Menery in first round of MMA fight, announces retirement
story_log.development: Former Heisman winner Manziel 'beat the brakes off' Bob Menery in first round, finishing via KO. Manziel announced retirement from MMA immediately after, ending his career at 1-0. Going out on top.

story_log.title: Supah Hot Fire knocks out Ray J in celebrity MMA fight
story_log.development: Internet personality Supah Hot Fire knocked out Ray J in first round. Video shows Ray J's eyes glazed over after KO, 'heard them saxophones.' Wild celebrity MMA night continues.

story_log.title: Kelsey Plum drops 38-9 against former team as Sparks upset Aces
story_log.development: Plum torched her former team with 38 pts, 9 ast on 12-17 FG in Sparks' 101-95 win over defending champion Aces. First 35+ pts, 5+ ast, 5+ 3PT game of her career. Averaging 32.5 ppg against Vegas this season. A'ja had 24-15-4b but it wasn't enough.

story_log.title: Travis Kelce chugs beer on jumbotron while Taylor Swift reacts at Cavs-Knicks Game 3
story_log.development: Kelce and Swift attended Game 3 courtside in Cleveland. Kelce chugged beer on jumbotron, cameras showed Taylor's reaction. W_B_Rick: 'Taylor might be first person to voluntarily become Cavs fan since LeBron left.' Broadcast kept showing Travis, barely mentioned Taylor.

story_log.title: Mike Trout homers in first inning for fourth straight game
story_log.development: Trout hit two-run blast in 1st inning vs Rangers on Sunday Night Baseball. Angels have now homered in first inning in four consecutive games. Angels look to sweep Texas for first time since 2022.

story_log.title: Elly De La Cruz goes opposite field for 3-run homer, Reds walk off Cardinals in 11th
story_log.development: Elly hit three-run homer the other way to give Reds lead. Jordan Walker tied it with two outs in 9th for Cards, but Reds walked it off in 11th inning. Elly now has just 3 homers in last 24 games after hot start.

story_log.title: Stephen Kolek throws complete game with just 2 strikeouts, third pitcher to do it this decade
story_log.development: Padres pitcher Kolek completed game with only 2 SO, joining Reid Detmers (2022) and Brad Keller (2020) as only pitchers this decade to do it. Rare throwback complete game performance.

story_log.title: Bills begin demolishing old stadium as new Highmark Stadium nears completion
story_log.development: With new Highmark Stadium on track to be ready for upcoming season, Bills have begun demolishing their old stadium piece by piece. Process expected to last into 2027. End of an era in Buffalo.

story_log.title: Bruno Fernandes breaks Premier League single-season assist record on final day
story_log.development: Manchester United midfielder set new Premier League record for most assists in a season on Matchday 38. Arsenal already crowned champions, but Bruno got his individual record on final day.

story_log.title: NASCAR legend Kyle Busch dies at 41 after pneumonia complications
story_log.development: Family released statement Friday: Busch died after severe pneumonia progressed into sepsis. 911 call obtained by AP revealed he experienced shortness of breath, felt overheating, and was coughing up blood day before death. Two-time Cup Series champion, one of NASCAR's all-time greats.

story_log.title: Thunder erase 15-0 deficit, take 2-1 series lead behind 71 bench points
story_log.development: OKC erased early 15-0 hole to win Game 3 in San Antonio 123-108. Thunder bench outscored Spurs' bench 71-18 (53-point margin, most in a CF/Finals game since 1971). Jared McCain exploded for 24 points off the bench (playoff career-high), Jaylin Williams added 18 on 5-6 from three in 21 minutes. SGA had 26-12 assists. Wemby posted 26 pts but only 1 rebound in second half. Jalen Williams ruled out before game (hamstring). Series shifts back to OKC for Game 4.

story_log.title: Golden Knights take 2-0 stranglehold after comeback in Colorado
story_log.development: Vegas rallied from 1-0 deficit late in Game 2, scored twice in final 2:14 (Barbashev bar-down, Eichel first goal in 10 games) to win 3-1 in Denver. Colorado was 45-0-0 when leading after 2 periods, now 45-1-0. Only 1945 Red Wings have won NHL best-of-7 semifinal after losing first two at home. Knights take commanding 2-0 lead back to Vegas for Game 3.

story_log.title: Gerrit Cole dominates in return: 6 IP, 0 R, hits 98.6 mph after 569 days
story_log.development: Cole threw 6 shutout innings (2 H, 3 BB, 2 SO) vs Rays in first MLB start since Tommy John surgery 569 days ago. Hit 98.6 mph on fastball. Yankees won 4-2 behind Rays bullpen implosion. Cole looked sharp, rotation finally gets ace back.

story_log.title: Jared McCain's 24-point breakout fuels Thunder comeback, Sixers roasted
story_log.development: McCain exploded for 24 points on 10-21 FG in Game 3, playoff career-high. Daryl Morey said in February 'I'm quite confident we were selling high' on McCain trade. Three months later McCain is dominating in WCF. Postgame: 'I love what my life is right now... I never want to take it for granted.' Internet roasting Sixers. StatMuse: McCain made more shots than both MVP finalists.

story_log.title: Spurs fans chant 'FLOPPER' at SGA, he says 'it does nothing'
story_log.development: Entire Spurs arena chanted 'FLOPPER' at SGA during Game 3. Spurs fan dressed as SGA in bubble wrap yelling 'TWO SHOTS! THAT'S A FOUL!' SGA postgame: 'It does nothing. Doesn't fuel me, doesn't discourage me. I've been dealing with it for a long time. I honestly like it. It makes the game more interesting.' Internet reaction viral. Lu Dort also dove into De'Aaron Fox's ankle, scuffle broke out, Isaiah Joe faked leaving bench and laughed at coaches.

story_log.title: Southern Miss hits walk-off grand slam down 3 with 2 outs, 0-2 count — then brawl
story_log.development: Drey Barrett hit walk-off grand slam in bottom of 9th down 3 runs, two outs, 0-2 count in conference tournament. Every backyard dream. Then #35 bumped Troy catcher, #32 came to defense, benches cleared. Peak college baseball chaos captured by Jomboy.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark drops 22-9 in return after back soreness scratch
story_log.development: Clark, who missed first game of season Wednesday due to back soreness, returned Friday vs Valkyries with 22 pts, 9 ast, 4 threes. Said returning from 2025 injuries is 'a real mental challenge.' Fever are 2-0. Leading league in APG with 9.

story_log.title: Si Woo Kim bogeys 18th to shoot 60 after flirting with 59 at Byron Nelson
story_log.development: Kim went bogey-free until final hole of round. Needed par on 18th to shoot 16th sub-60 round in PGA Tour history. Bogeyed to shoot 60. Still took five-shot lead into weekend. Scheffler and Spieth in hunt.

story_log.title: Mississippi State rallies from 4 down to stun Oklahoma in Norman, snaps Sooners' 18-game Super Regional streak
story_log.development: Since 2000, Oklahoma softball was 77-0 when leading by 4+ in Regional/Super Regional. Now 77-1 after Mississippi State rallied in Norman to end OU's 18-game Supers win streak. Oklahoma had led 6-2. MSU scored 9 runs in final two innings to win Game 1 in stunning fashion. Tennessee punched first WCWS ticket by sweeping Georgia.

story_log.title: Oliver McBurnie's 95th-minute goal sends Hull City to Premier League
story_log.development: McBurnie scored in 95th minute of Championship playoff final to beat Middlesbrough, sends Hull to Premier League. Tigers return to English first division. Middlesbrough got lifeline after Southampton's shock spygate disqualification but couldn't capitalize.

story_log.title: Anthony Edwards on Wemby ejection: 'I was so happy that n***a got kicked out'
story_log.development: Edwards on when Wembanyama got ejected for elbowing Naz Reid: 'That n**** like 8'5... The rim aint nothing but 10 feet... I was so happy that n**** got kicked out... I hope they suspend him. Imma email they ass right now!' Hilarious reaction from Ant captured on his YouTube channel.

story_log.title: Daryl Morey says he was using ChatGPT during Jared McCain trade negotiations before service crashed
story_log.development: NBA Centel reporting Morey admitted he was using ChatGPT during McCain trade negotiations before service crashed. Would explain a lot about how that deal went down. Internet roasting Sixers again after McCain's 24-point WCF performance.

story_log.title: Thunder take 2-1 series lead after erasing early 15-0 deficit behind monster bench performance
story_log.development: OKC erased early 15-0 hole to win Game 3 in San Antonio 123-108. Thunder bench outscored Spurs' bench 71-18 (53-point margin). Jared McCain exploded for 24 points off the bench (playoff career high), Jaylin Williams added 18 points on 5-6 from three in 21 minutes. SGA had 26-12 assists, 12-of-12 FT. Wemby posted 26 pts but only 1 rebound in second half. Series shifts back to OKC for Game 4 with defending champs now one win from Finals.

story_log.title: Golden Knights take 2-0 stranglehold on Avalanche after rallying late in Colorado
story_log.development: Vegas rallied from 1-0 deficit late in Game 2, scored twice in final 2:14 to win 3-1 in Denver. Ivan Barbashev scored go-ahead goal bar-down, Jack Eichel added insurance (first goal in 10 games). Colorado was 45-0-0 this season when leading after 2 periods, now 45-1-0. Only the 1945 Red Wings have ever won an NHL best-of-7 semifinal series after losing first two at home. Knights take commanding 2-0 lead back to Vegas.

story_log.title: Gerrit Cole dominates in return from 569-day layoff: 6 IP, 0 R, hits 98.6 mph
story_log.development: Cole threw 6 shutout innings with 2 hits, 3 walks, 2 strikeouts vs Rays in first MLB start since Tommy John surgery 569 days ago. Hit 98.6 mph on fastball. Yankees won 4-2 behind Rays bullpen implosion. Cole looked sharp, Yankees rotation finally gets their ace back.

story_log.title: Kyle Manzardo pinch-hit homer breaks scoreless tie, lifts Guardians past Phillies in 9th
story_log.development: Gavin Williams threw 8 scoreless innings with 11 strikeouts, matched by Phillies ace Cristopher Sanchez. Game stayed 0-0 until Manzardo delivered pinch-hit homer in 9th to give Cleveland 1-0 win. Williams is first Guardians pitcher with 8+ IP and 11+ SO in a start since Triston McKenzie in 2022. Elite pitching showcase ends with clutch pinch-hit drama.

story_log.title: Jared McCain posts playoff career-high 24 points off bench, fuels Thunder comeback
story_log.development: McCain exploded for 24 points on 10-21 FG in Game 3, playoff career high. Daryl Morey said in February 'I'm quite confident we were selling high' on McCain trade to OKC. Three months later McCain is dropping 24 in WCF to help Thunder take 2-1 series lead. Internet roasting Sixers for trading him. McCain postgame: 'I love what my life is right now.'

story_log.title: Spurs fans chant 'FLOPPER' at SGA as tensions rise in physical Game 3
story_log.development: Entire Spurs arena chanted 'FLOPPER' at Shai Gilgeous-Alexander during Game 3. SGA postgame: 'It does nothing. Doesn't fuel me, doesn't discourage me. I've been dealing with it for a long time.' Spurs fan dressed as SGA in bubble wrap yelling 'TWO SHOTS! THAT'S A FOUL!' Also: Lu Dort dove into De'Aaron Fox's previously injured ankle, Fox left game holding ankle. Scuffle broke out, Isaiah Joe faked like he'd leave bench and laughed at coaches. Series getting chippy.

story_log.title: Southern Miss hits walk-off grand slam down 3 with 2 outs, 0-2 count — then brawl breaks out
story_log.development: Southern Miss' Drey Barrett hit walk-off grand slam in bottom of 9th down 3 runs, two outs, 0-2 count in conference tournament. Every baseball kid's backyard dream. Then #35 bumped Troy catcher, #32 came to catcher's defense, benches cleared. Peak college baseball chaos.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark says coming back from 2025 injuries is 'a real mental challenge'
story_log.development: Clark, who missed first game of season Wednesday due to back soreness, acknowledged that returning from her 2025 injuries is 'a real mental challenge.' Dropped 22-9-4 in return vs Valkyries. Fever are 2-0 to start season. Year 3 off to strong start despite lingering injury concerns.

story_log.title: Giants DL Roy Robertson-Harris tears Achilles at OTAs, out for 2026 season
story_log.development: Robertson-Harris tore his Achilles tendon at Thursday's OTA workout and is expected to miss entire 2026 season. Significant blow to Giants defensive line depth in year one under John Harbaugh.

story_log.title: Matthew Stafford and Rams finalize 1-year, $55M extension through 2027
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Stafford officially signed one-year, $55M extension (up to $60M with incentives). Now tied to LA through 2027 season with $105M remaining. Brought family to sign contract. Reigning MVP at 38 betting on two more years.

story_log.title: Lions extend All-Pro LB Jack Campbell through 2030 on 4-year, $81M deal
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Detroit signed Campbell to four-year extension through 2030 worth $81M with $51.5M guaranteed per Ian Rapoport. First player from Lions' 2023 draft class to get extended. Team locking in core after deep playoff runs.

story_log.title: Eagles LB Nolan Smith arrested for speeding at 135 mph in 70 mph zone
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Smith arrested Friday in Georgia on speeding and reckless driving charges after car clocked at 135 mph in 70 mph zone. Second-year LB facing serious charges entering 2026 season.

story_log.title: Si Woo Kim bogeys 18th to shoot 60 after flirting with 59 at Byron Nelson
story_log.development: Kim went bogey-free until final hole of round at CJ Cup Byron Nelson. Needed par on 18th to shoot 16th sub-60 round in PGA Tour history. Bogeyed to shoot 60. Still took five-shot lead into the weekend. Scheffler and Spieth in the hunt.

story_log.title: Tarps Off movement spreads nationwide as crews hit Oracle Park, Milwaukee, Kansas City
story_log.development: Tarps Off crews showed up at multiple stadiums Friday night: Oracle Park (Giants down five), Milwaukee, Kansas City (got usher to join in). Movement going national. Jomboy Media documenting the spread.

story_log.title: Chadwick Tromp walks off Nationals in 11th as Braves keep finding ways to win
story_log.development: Tromp hit walk-off single in 11th inning to give Braves 5-4 win over Nationals. Atlanta continues to scratch out wins every single night. 30-13 record, best in MLB.

story_log.title: Former Wisconsin guard John Blackwell withdraws from NBA Draft, transfers to Duke
story_log.development: Blackwell withdrew from 2026 NBA Draft to transfer to Duke for senior year. Averaged 19.1 ppg for Wisconsin last season. Major pickup for Coach K's Blue Devils. Rothstein and Haynes both reported.

story_log.title: NCAA opened Ole Miss investigation same day Dabo Swinney accused Pete Golding of tampering
story_log.development: NCAA enforcement staff opened investigation of Ole Miss football program the same day Clemson coach Dabo Swinney publicly accused Rebels coach Pete Golding of tampering with LB Luke Ferrelli. Timing raises questions about whether Dabo complaint triggered probe.

story_log.title: Ed Orgeron returns to LSU as assistant under Lane Kiffin, seven years after national title
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Coach O hired as special assistant to recruiting and defense at LSU under new coach Lane Kiffin. Decades-long friendship between the two. Pardon My Take aired interview with both at LSU facilities. Orgeron on Brian Kelly's 'faaaaymly' introduction: discussed on PMT.

story_log.title: Pep Guardiola confirms he is leaving Manchester City at end of season after 10 years
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Guardiola officially confirmed he will leave City at end of season after nearly a decade of dominance. Won 16 major trophies including multiple Premier League titles. Michael Carrick named permanent manager at Man United. Premier League changing forever.

story_log.title: NASCAR legend Kyle Busch dies at 41
story_log.development: Two-time Cup Series champion Kyle Busch died at age 41 after illness. NASCAR community mourns loss of all-time great and fierce competitor.

story_log.title: Knicks take 2-0 stranglehold on Cavs behind Josh Hart's career playoff high
story_log.development: New York won Game 2 109-93 at MSG behind Josh Hart's playoff career-high 26 points on 5-of-11 from three. Cavs dared Hart to shoot, he buried them. Brunson had 19-14 assists (most by Knick in playoff game since 1998). Knicks have won 9 straight playoff games, take 2-0 series lead to Cleveland.

story_log.title: Canadiens hand Hurricanes first playoff loss with 6-2 statement win
story_log.development: Montreal won Game 1 of ECF 6-2 in Raleigh, ending Carolina's 8-0 playoff run. Canadiens scored 6 goals in Game 1 — more than Hurricanes allowed in entire Ottawa series (5 total). Juraj Slafkovsky had 2 goals, 3 points.

story_log.title: Rams extend reigning MVP Matthew Stafford with $55M deal for 2026 season
story_log.development: Stafford and Rams agreed to 1-year, $55M extension (up to $60M with incentives) keeping 38-year-old QB through 2027. Comes weeks after Rams drafted Ty Simpson at No. 13. Stafford won MVP in 2025, led Rams to Super Bowl in 2021. Now two years, $105M remaining on deal.

story_log.title: Tuchel snubs Trent Alexander-Arnold, Phil Foden, and Cole Palmer from England World Cup squad
story_log.development: England announced 26-man World Cup roster with massive surprises: Trent Alexander-Arnold, Phil Foden, and Cole Palmer all left off squad. Ivan Toney made the cut. Tuchel's bold selections spark controversy weeks before tournament.

story_log.title: Giants extend GM Joe Schoen to multi-year deal alongside John Harbaugh
story_log.development: New York signed GM Schoen to multi-year extension, securing front office continuity with new head coach John Harbaugh. Schoen delivered mixed results on first contract but ownership committed to pairing.

story_log.title: Lions lock up All-Pro LB Jack Campbell with 4-year extension
story_log.development: Detroit signed All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell to four-year extension through 2030 season. First player from Lions' 2023 draft class to get extended. Deals for Gibbs, LaPorta, and Branch expected to follow.

story_log.title: WNBA issues Fever warning for leaving Caitlin Clark off injury report
story_log.development: League fined and warned Indiana for late scratch controversy after Clark was left off injury report before game. Clark officially listed as probable for Friday's game vs Valkyries.

story_log.title: Blue Jays blank Yankees 2-0 as Bombers go ice cold
story_log.development: Toronto shut out Yankees 2-0. New York's offense in last 2 games: 9-for-62 (.145 AVG), 0 HR, 1 run. StatMuse notes Yankees have fewest games (9) vs teams above .500, are 1-8 in those games.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll walks it off for Diamondbacks in 10th inning
story_log.development: Carroll hit walk-off line drive in extras to give Arizona 2-1 win over Rockies. A's also won in extras after overturned call at first base gave them 10th-inning lead.

story_log.title: Josh Hart destroys analytics: 'They're lamp posts to a drunk person'
story_log.development: Hart on analytics after career playoff night: 'They're lamp posts to a drunk person. You can lean on them, but it won't get you home.' KAT couldn't believe he said it. Hart also pulled up to presser eating pizza.

story_log.title: NFLPA makes JAMs the exclusive PB&J sandwich of the Players Association
story_log.development: NFLPA reached agreement with JAMs (co-owned by JJ Watt and Caleb Williams) to become exclusive peanut butter-and-jelly sandwich provider league-wide this season. Schefter broke the massive news.

story_log.title: Golden State Valkyries beat Liberty 87-70 in franchise debut
story_log.development: Valkyries won first game in franchise history, beating defending champion Liberty 87-70. Dearica Hamby had 27-15-7 on 7-11 FG for Sparks in separate game.

story_log.title: Thunder tie series 1-1 behind SGA's bounce-back 30-bomb and Isaiah Hartenstein's physicality on Wemby
story_log.development: OKC evened series at 1-1 with dominant home win behind SGA's 30-9-2 and only 1 turnover. Isaiah Hartenstein played entire 4th quarter (10 pts, 13 reb, 8 OREB) bodying Wemby who finished with 21-17-6-4b but just 4 points in the 4th. Spurs lost Dylan Harper to right leg injury in 2nd half, adding to De'Aaron Fox absence. Thunder forced 21 turnovers including Stephon Castle's 9 (20 total over first two games, most in CF history). Alex Caruso added 17-5 off bench. Jalen Williams (hamstring tightness) didn't return after first half.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle sets conference finals record with 20 turnovers through two games, still delivers 25-5-8 in Game 2
story_log.development: Castle committed 9 turnovers in Game 2 (11 in Game 1), setting CF record for most turnovers through first two games (20) in NBA history. Despite turnover issues, still posted 25 points, 5 rebounds, 8 assists. At 21, became youngest player ever with 30-10-5-5 in playoffs (Game 1) and youngest with 25-5-8 in CF game.

story_log.title: Golden Knights steal Game 1 in Colorado as Avalanche play without Cale Makar
story_log.development: Vegas took Game 1 of WCF 4-2 in Denver despite Avalanche playing without Cale Makar (day-to-day injury). Dylan Coghlan scored first career playoff goal, Carter Hart made 36 saves, Mitch Marner fed Pavel Dorofeyev for insurance goal. Valeri Nichushkin scored between-the-legs goal for Colorado. Series shifts to Vegas for Game 2.

story_log.title: Aaron Rodgers confirms he will retire after 2026 season, ending 22-year career
story_log.development: Rodgers officially announced 2026 will be his final NFL season at Steelers OTAs. 'This is it,' he told reporters. Will turn 43 in December. Faces brutal schedule including five games vs top-4 pass defenses from 2025. SharpFootball analysis shows NFL gave Steelers easiest schedule through Week 8 to keep 'Rodgers farewell tour' in primetime.

story_log.title: Eagles LB Nolan Smith arrested after being clocked at 135 mph in 70 mph zone
story_log.development: Smith was arrested Friday in Georgia on speeding and reckless driving charges after car clocked at 135 mph in 70 mph zone. Second-year linebacker facing serious charges ahead of 2026 season.

story_log.title: Ed Orgeron returns to LSU as assistant to Lane Kiffin, seven years after national title
story_log.development: Coach O hired as special assistant to recruiting and defense under new LSU coach Lane Kiffin. Led LSU to 2019 national championship as head coach before being fired in 2021. Decades-long friendship with Kiffin. Pardon My Take interviewed both at LSU facilities during Grit Week.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani homers on first pitch then throws 5 scoreless innings in Dodgers win
story_log.development: Ohtani led off game with homer on first pitch vs Padres, then pitched 5 scoreless innings (44 IP this season, still under 1.00 ERA at 0.73). Escaped bases-loaded jam in 5th with roar. Historic two-way dominance continues.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong calls his back-to-back errors 'genuinely laughable'
story_log.development: Cubs center fielder called his errors over past two games 'laughable' after ball scooted under glove in 2nd inning of 5-0 loss to Brewers. Tough couple days for PCA defensively.

story_log.title: Trey Yesavage outduels Cam Schlittler in young ace showdown as Blue Jays beat Yankees 2-1
story_log.development: Blue Jays' Yesavage bested Yankees' Schlittler in marquee matchup of young aces. Toronto won 2-1 in pitcher's duel. Yesavage struck out Aaron Judge three times (19 Ks in 11.1 IP vs NYY this season including playoffs).

story_log.title: Joey Chestnut to defend hot dog title while on probation after pleading guilty to battery
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: 17-time Nathan's champion will compete in July 4 contest while on probation after pleading guilty to misdemeanor battery charge. Still the reigning champ despite legal issues.

story_log.title: Raiders' Klint Kubiak says No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza has been 'as advertised' in first month
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Raiders coach praised Mendoza's strong first month with team. No. 1 overall pick making positive impression in OTAs. Schefter highlighted Kubiak's comments about Mendoza meeting expectations.

story_log.title: Joe Burrow declares 2026 Bengals 'most talented' roster of his era after big offseason
story_log.development: Burrow told media he believes this year's Bengals squad is most talented roster he's played with since joining franchise. Changed tune after calling for change at end of last season. Kid Cudi visited practice after Cincinnati concert.

story_log.title: Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, Kon Knueppel headline unanimous All-Rookie First Team
story_log.development: NBA announced All-Rookie teams with Flagg, Harper, and Knueppel as unanimous first-team selections. VJ Edgecombe and Cedric Coward also made first team. Ace Bailey, Jeremiah Fears, Collin Murray-Boyles, Maxime Raynaud, and Derik Queen on second team. Neither rookie APG or BPG leader made a team.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle baptizes Isaiah Hartenstein with vicious poster dunk
story_log.development: Castle threw down poster dunk on Hartenstein in Game 2, leaving Wemby and SGA in shock on bench. One of dunks of the year. Hartenstein later appeared to grab Castle's hair and pull him down (no call).

story_log.title: Spurs-Thunder Game 1 averaged 9.2M viewers, most-watched WCF Game 1 in league history
story_log.development: Monday's double-OT thriller peaked at 12M viewers, averaged 9.2M on NBC/Peacock. Most-watched Western Conference finals Game 1 in NBA history. Wemby vs SGA drawing massive numbers.

story_log.title: Brewers and Athletics both score on little-league home runs in wild night
story_log.development: Dom Smith's little-league HR scared Chris Sale. Pete Crow-Armstrong let ball scoot under glove, Brewers scored on error. Later Mike Trout and Josh Lowe both botched fly ball in extras, A's took lead and won.

story_log.title: Blue Jays' Jose Berrios undergoes Tommy John surgery, out into 2027
story_log.development: Veteran Blue Jays starter underwent full Tommy John surgery on right elbow Wednesday. Will be sidelined well into 2027 season. Blow to Toronto rotation.

story_log.title: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice ordered to serve 30 days in jail immediately after probation violation
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Rice sentenced to serve 30 days immediately in Dallas County jail after testing positive for marijuana in violation of probation. Also recovering from knee surgery (out 2 months). Will rehab while incarcerated, miss all OTAs and minicamp.

story_log.title: NFL approves 10 international games starting in 2027, strips teams' ability to protect home games
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: NFL owners voted to increase cap on international games from 8 to 10 in 2027. Also eliminated teams' ability to protect any home games from being played abroad. Could reach 11 with NFLPA approval. Major expansion of global footprint.

story_log.title: Knicks pull off historic 22-point comeback in Game 1 ECF, Brunson hunts Harden in largest playoff comeback since 1970
story_log.development: Knicks rallied from 22 points down with 7 minutes left in 4Q, went on 44-11 run to force OT and win 115-104. Jalen Brunson hunted James Harden repeatedly down the stretch, finished with 38-5-6. Harden had 15 pts, 5-16 FG, 6 TOV, 5 fouls. Largest playoff comeback win in Knicks history and since 1970. Cavs blew 99.9% win probability.

story_log.title: Mavs fire Jason Kidd as Masai Ujiri makes first major move
story_log.development: Dallas fired coach Jason Kidd with four years and $40M+ remaining on contract. Masai Ujiri's first major decision as new president. Kidd took Mavs to 2024 Finals but missed playoffs in last two seasons. Doc Rivers reportedly contacted about return.

story_log.title: Rashee Rice ordered to serve 30 days in jail, will miss OTAs and minicamp while rehabbing knee surgery
story_log.development: Rice must serve 30-day jail sentence for probation violation (tested positive for marijuana) tied to 2024 multi-car crash. Also underwent knee surgery last week to remove loose debris, expected out two months. Will rehab while incarcerated, miss all OTAs and minicamp.

story_log.title: Nashville officially awarded Super Bowl LXIV in 2030, Minneapolis gets 2028 Draft
story_log.development: NFL owners approved Nashville as Super Bowl LXIV host (February 2030) by unanimous 32-0 vote. Minneapolis awarded 2028 NFL Draft. Nashville will have 80,000 hotel rooms by 2030 (up from 62,000 now). First Super Bowl for Music City.

story_log.title: Arsenal end 22-year Premier League title drought after Man City draw
story_log.development: Arsenal clinched first Premier League title since 2004 after Man City drew at Bournemouth. Mikel Arteta's seven-year rebuild complete.

story_log.title: Yankees ace Gerrit Cole to make first MLB start since 2024 on Friday
story_log.development: Cole will make first major-league start Friday vs Rays, first appearance since undergoing Tommy John surgery last spring.

story_log.title: Joey Chestnut pleads guilty to battery after bar incident, on probation through July 4
story_log.development: Hot dog-eating champion pleaded guilty to battery charge after bar incident. Will be on probation through July 4th weekend — his most important weekend of the year.

story_log.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's Offensive Player of the Year trophy says 'Defensive Player of the Year'
story_log.development: NFL gave JSN his Offensive Player of the Year trophy with plaque reading 'Defensive Player of the Year.' JSN: 'It's getting disrespectful at this point.' NFL will send corrected trophy.

story_log.title: NFL approves 10 international games in 2027, changes scheduling policy
story_log.development: NFL owners voted to increase cap on international games from 8 to 10 in 2027 (not including Jags Wembley game = 11 total possible). Also eliminated teams' ability to protect two home games from being played abroad. Japan mentioned as future frontier.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark to serve as grand marshal of Indianapolis 500
story_log.development: Fever guard Clark will be grand marshal of Indy 500 this Sunday during six-day break in Fever schedule.

story_log.title: James Wood hits inside-the-park grand slam for Nationals
story_log.development: Wood hit inside-the-park grand slam as Nationals beat Mets 9-6. Center fielder completely botched the play.

story_log.title: Ketel Marte walk-off homer with two outs in ninth gives Diamondbacks comeback win
story_log.development: Marte hit walk-off homer with Arizona down to last out against Giants. Dodgers also rallied late to beat Padres and reclaim first place in NL West.

story_log.title: NCAA takes big step toward adding flag football as championship sport by 2028
story_log.development: NCAA moving toward formal approval of flag football as championship sport by 2028. Expected to be approved by all three divisions in 2027.

story_log.title: Bills WR Keon Coleman says this is a 'make or break' year for him
story_log.development: Coleman told media 2026 is 'make or break year' for him after disappointing rookie season. Entering Year 2 with high expectations.

story_log.title: Knicks pull off historic 22-point comeback in Game 1, largest playoff comeback since 1970
story_log.development: Knicks rallied from 22 points down with 7 minutes left in 4Q, went on 44-11 run to force OT and win 115-104. Jalen Brunson hunted James Harden repeatedly down the stretch, finished with 38-5-6. Largest playoff comeback win in Knicks history and since 1970. Cavs blew 99.9% win probability.

story_log.title: Mavs fire Jason Kidd as Masai Ujiri makes first major move
story_log.development: Dallas fired coach Jason Kidd with four years and $40M+ remaining on contract. Masai Ujiri's first major decision as new president. Kidd took Mavs to 2024 Finals but missed playoffs in last two seasons. Doc Rivers reportedly contacted about return.

story_log.title: Rashee Rice ordered to serve 30 days in jail after testing positive for weed, will miss OTAs and minicamp
story_log.development: Rice must serve 30-day jail sentence for probation violation (tested positive for marijuana) tied to 2024 multi-car crash. Also underwent knee surgery last week to remove loose debris, expected out two months. Will rehab while incarcerated, miss all OTAs and minicamp.

story_log.title: Nashville officially awarded Super Bowl LXIV in 2030, Minneapolis gets 2028 Draft
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: NFL owners approved Nashville as Super Bowl LXIV host (February 2030) by unanimous 32-0 vote. Minneapolis awarded 2028 NFL Draft. Nashville will have 80,000 hotel rooms by 2030 (up from 62,000 now). First Super Bowl for Music City.

story_log.title: Arsenal end 22-year Premier League title drought after Man City draw
story_log.development: Arsenal clinched first Premier League title since 2004 after Man City drew at Bournemouth. Mikel Arteta's seven-year rebuild complete. Stan Kroenke's sports empire now includes Super Bowl, Stanley Cup, NBA title, and Premier League crown this decade.

story_log.title: Yankees ace Gerrit Cole to make first MLB start since 2024 on Friday
story_log.development: Cole will make first major-league start Friday vs Rays, first appearance since undergoing Tommy John surgery last spring. Big moment for Yankees rotation.

story_log.title: Joey Chestnut pleads guilty to battery after bar incident, on probation through July 4
story_log.development: Hot dog-eating champion pleaded guilty to battery charge after bar incident. Will be on probation through July 4th weekend — his most important weekend of the year. Details on run-in with law two months before Nathan's contest.

story_log.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's Offensive Player of the Year trophy says 'Defensive Player of the Year'
story_log.development: NFL gave JSN his Offensive Player of the Year trophy with plaque reading 'Defensive Player of the Year.' JSN: 'It's getting disrespectful at this point.' NFL claims ownership and will send corrected trophy.

story_log.title: NFL approves 10 international games in 2027, changes scheduling policy
story_log.development: NFL owners voted to increase cap on international games from 8 to 10 in 2027 (not including Jags Wembley game = 11 total possible). Also eliminated teams' ability to protect two home games from being played abroad. Could go to 11 with NFLPA approval. Japan mentioned as future frontier.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark to serve as grand marshal of Indianapolis 500
story_log.development: Fever guard Clark will be grand marshal of Indy 500 this Sunday during six-day break in Fever schedule. Iconic race, iconic rookie in Year 3.

story_log.title: James Wood hits inside-the-park grand slam for Nationals
story_log.development: Wood hit inside-the-park grand slam as Nationals beat Mets 9-6. Center fielder completely botched the play. Rare and absurd moment.

story_log.title: Ketel Marte walk-off homer with two outs in ninth gives Diamondbacks comeback win
story_log.development: Marte hit walk-off homer with Arizona down to last out against Giants. Dodgers also rallied late to beat Padres 5-4 and reclaim first place in NL West.

story_log.title: NCAA takes big step toward adding flag football as championship sport by 2028
story_log.development: NCAA moving toward formal approval of flag football as championship sport by 2028. Expected to be approved by all three divisions in 2027.

story_log.title: Bills WR Keon Coleman says this is a 'make or break' year for him
story_log.development: Coleman told media 2026 is 'make or break year' for him after disappointing rookie season. Entering Year 2 with high expectations in Buffalo.

story_log.title: Victor Wembanyama's 41-24-3b legendary Game 1 in double OT WCF
story_log.development: Wemby put on all-time legendary performance in Game 1 double-OT thriller: 41 points, 24 rebounds, 3 blocks, 14-25 FG. Hit logo 3-pointer to tie game in OT. Youngest player ever with 40-20 playoff game. Spurs stunned Thunder 122-115 in double OT to take 1-0 series lead. Dylan Harper had 24-11-6-7 steals (first 20/10/5/5 CF game since Bird), Alex Caruso 31 points off bench (most off bench in CF since 2020).

story_log.title: Canadiens advance to Conference Finals after Game 7 OT win over Sabres
story_log.development: Montreal advanced to Eastern Conference Finals with 3-2 OT win in Game 7 at Buffalo. Alex Newhook scored game-winner in OT (his 2nd Game 7 OT goal this postseason). Sabres eliminated after epic series. Canadiens reach ECF for first time since 2021.

story_log.title: J.T. Ginn loses no-hitter and game in span of 4 pitches
story_log.development: A's pitcher J.T. Ginn took no-hitter into 9th inning vs Angels with game still 0-0. Adam Frazier broke it up with single with zero outs, then Zach Neto hit walk-off homer four pitches later. Angels won 2-1. MLB still hasn't seen no-hitter since 2024 season.

story_log.title: Aaron Rodgers officially signs 1-year, $25M deal with Steelers
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Rodgers officially signed one-year contract worth up to $25M with Pittsburgh. Appeared at OTAs at 7am before first practice. Will be backup to Will Howard in 22nd NFL season. McCarthy gave Howard extended look before Rodgers returned.

story_log.title: NFL expected to award 2028 Draft to Minneapolis, Super Bowl LXIV to Nashville
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: NFL owners expected to vote Tuesday at Spring League Meeting to award 2028 Draft to Minneapolis and Super Bowl LXIV (February 2030) to Nashville. Nashville would be first Super Bowl for Music City.

story_log.title: Pelicans hire Jamahl Mosley as new head coach on 5-year deal
story_log.development: New Orleans hired Jamahl Mosley on five-year contract after he was dismissed by Magic on May 4. Mosley led Magic to three consecutive playoff berths and built elite defenses (No. 3 in '23-24, No. 2 in '24-25). Pelicans see parallels to Magic rebuild.

story_log.title: Pep Guardiola to leave Manchester City at season's end after 10 years
story_log.development: Guardiola will leave City at end of season after 10 years, 16 major trophies including Saturday's FA Cup final win. Enzo Maresca expected successor. End of an era for Premier League dynasty.

story_log.title: Jeff Bezos heavy favorite to buy Seattle Seahawks
story_log.development: Bezos is heavy Polymarket favorite to buy Seahawks. His $259B net worth is higher than top five NFL owners combined (Walton, Hunt, Tepper, Kroenke, Jones). Would reset NFL ownership wealth dynamics.

story_log.title: Texas Tech QB Brendan Sorsby files injunction vs NCAA seeking 2026 eligibility
story_log.development: Sorsby, who took indefinite hiatus in April to seek treatment for gambling addiction, filed injunction Monday seeking college eligibility for 2026 season. NFL set supplemental draft deadline for June 22. Sorsby must decide between college and pros.

story_log.title: Colby Covington retires from UFC after career as top welterweight contender
story_log.development: Former interim welterweight champion Covington notified UFC of intent to retire. Challenged for world title three times. End of controversial, successful UFC career.

story_log.title: Neymar makes Brazil's 26-man World Cup roster despite injury concerns
story_log.development: Former Barca and PSG superstar Neymar made Carlo Ancelotti's 26-man Brazil World Cup squad. Chelsea's Joao Pedro missed out. Big story was whether Neymar's fitness would hold up for roster inclusion.

story_log.title: Conor McGregor return against Max Holloway previewed for UFC 329 July 11
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: CBS Sports and media previewing McGregor-Holloway rematch (original fight in 2013). McGregor's first fight in 5 years at 170 lbs. Jorge Masvidal predicts 'Max smokes him like a brisket.' Would cap incredible summer for UFC.

story_log.title: NFL may vote to add two more international games, change scheduling policy
story_log.development: NFL might change key scheduling policy for international games and vote to add two more matchups per reports. League expanding global footprint aggressively.

story_log.title: Colt Emerson's first MLB hit is a three-run homer for Mariners
story_log.development: League's No. 6 overall prospect Emerson (who got $95M extension from Seattle in March) hit three-run homer for his first career MLB hit. Moment for one of baseball's top young talents.

story_log.title: Cavs blow out Pistons in Game 7, advance to Eastern Conference Finals vs Knicks
story_log.development: Cleveland won Game 7 in Detroit 125-94, ending Pistons' season. Donovan Mitchell had 26-7-8-0 TOV, Jarrett Allen 23-7, Sam Merrill 23 off bench. Cade and Duren combined for 20 points in elimination game. Cavs reach ECF for first time since 2018, face Knicks starting Tuesday.

story_log.title: Aaron Rai becomes first English player to win PGA Championship in 107 years
story_log.development: Rai won his first major at Aronimink, closing with incredible approach from 68 feet and steady putting. First player from England to win PGA since 1919. Wore two gloves (childhood habit from cold English weather) and iron covers (tribute to working-class father who cleaned clubs with pin and baby oil). Jim Nantz called it with Rocky reference.

story_log.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander wins second consecutive NBA MVP
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Full voting results released Sunday night. SGA becomes 14th player ever to win back-to-back MVPs, first guard since Curry (2014-16). Averaged 30+ pts on 55% shooting, never scored below 20 all season. Luka received 0 first-place votes despite leading NBA in scoring. Blake Griffin roasted Shams for spoiling it on a Sunday.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark sets WNBA record with third career 20-10 game
story_log.development: Clark had 21-7-10-2b in Fever win over Storm. Now has three 20-point/10-assist games in her career — more than any player in WNBA history. Fever are 2-0 to start season. Clark becoming the face of the league in Year 3.

story_log.title: Nashville expected to be awarded Super Bowl LXIV in 2030
story_log.development: NFL owners will vote Tuesday at Spring League Meeting to award Super Bowl LXIV (February 2030) to Nashville. Would be first Super Bowl for Music City, showcase for Titans' new stadium.

story_log.title: Edgar Quero walk-off homer gives White Sox series win over Cubs
story_log.development: Quero hit walk-off homer in extras to give Sox series win over Cubs in crosstown rivalry. Pete Crow-Armstrong exchanged words with White Sox fan at her engagement party. Cubs bullpen blew late lead. Chicago baseball drama at its finest.

story_log.title: Phillies climb back above .500 after atrocious start to season
story_log.development: Philadelphia swept Pirates to move above .500 for first time this season. Have won 15 of last 19 games. Remarkable turnaround from brutal April.

story_log.title: Mets walk off Yankees 7-6 to take Subway Series
story_log.development: Tyrone Taylor 3-run homer in 9th with Mets down to last out tied it. Mets won in extras to take series. Brandon Nimmo robbed HR in front of Astros fans then gave them a ball. Yankees struggling.

story_log.title: Roki Sasaki throws first 7-inning start in MLB career
story_log.development: Sasaki went 7 IP, 4 H, 1 ER, 0 BB, 8 SO vs Angels in Dodgers' 10-1 win. First time he's completed 7 innings in the majors. Dodgers sweep Halos in Freeway Series.

story_log.title: James Franklin on coaching at Virginia Tech: 'I've got a chip on my shoulder'
story_log.development: Franklin gave commencement speech at Miami University, discussed getting fired by Penn State and turning down $40M buyout to immediately return to coaching. Says he's in 'win-now mode' at Virginia Tech. First public comments on Penn State departure and Virginia Tech hire.

story_log.title: Chelsea Gray hits game-winner with 0.7 left, Aces beat Dream 85-84
story_log.development: Gray made clutch bucket with 0.7 seconds left, then stole inbound to seal win. Becky Hammon: 'The bigger the moment, the bigger she gets.' Gray proving she's still the most clutch player in the WNBA.

story_log.title: Giants bring back thrusting celebration despite ban
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 6]: Giants refuse to acknowledge their thrusting ban. Players went back to the explicit celebration after briefly doing polite bows. Beat Athletics 10-1. Harrison Bader hit grand slam in 8-run inning.

story_log.title: Conor McGregor return against Max Holloway set for UFC 329 on July 11
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: CBS Sports previewing McGregor-Holloway rematch (original fight in 2013). McGregor's first fight in 5 years at 170 lbs. Would cap incredible summer for UFC with White House event and stacked Vegas card.

story_log.title: Bill Belichick on Pardon My Take for Grit Week 2026
story_log.development: PMT drops interview with Bill Belichick to kick off Grit Week 2026. PFT says interview lasted 'about an hour and a half' and 'could have talked to him forever.' Big Cat called it 'incredible show.' PMT finally landed their white whale.

story_log.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander wins second consecutive NBA MVP
story_log.development: Shams Charania broke news that SGA won his second consecutive MVP award, joining 13 other players in league history to win back-to-back. First guard to do so since Curry in 2014-16.

story_log.title: 42-year-old Aaron Rodgers returns to Steelers on one-year, $25M deal
story_log.development: Schefter reported Rodgers and Steelers agreed to terms on one-year deal worth up to $25M. Reunites with Mike McCarthy for 22nd NFL season. Expected at OTAs Monday.

story_log.title: Sabres erase 3-1 deficit, force Game 7 in Montreal with 8-3 blowout
story_log.development: Buffalo dominated Game 6 in Montreal 8-3 to tie series 3-3. Rasmus Dahlin had 5 points (first defenseman in Sabres history with 5 pts in playoff game). Jack Quinn scored twice. Series returns to Buffalo for Game 7 Monday.

story_log.title: Conor McGregor announces return to UFC against Max Holloway on July 11
story_log.development: Dana White announced McGregor will fight Max Holloway at UFC 329 in Las Vegas on July 11 at 170 lbs. McGregor's first fight since 2021, rematch of 2013 bout McGregor won by UD.

story_log.title: Ronda Rousey submits Gina Carano in 17 seconds on Netflix MMA card
story_log.development: Rousey submitted Carano in just 17 seconds in their long-awaited fight on Netflix. SharpFootball tweeted the broadcast literally leaked Rousey's game plan and the fight ended in 17 seconds.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani gets little-league home run after controversial ground-rule double ruling
story_log.development: Ohtani hit line drive that appeared to go over wall but was ruled in play. He ran around bases for inside-the-park homer. Umpires reviewed and kept it in play, gifting him a little-league homer.

story_log.title: Dodgers demolish Angels 15-2 as Alek Manoah implodes
story_log.development: Dodgers crushed Angels 15-2. Manoah's final line: 1.1 IP, 6 H, 8 ER, 3 BB, 59 pitches. Jose Soriano also struggled: 5.1 IP, 6 ER, 6 BB.

story_log.title: Texas Tech softball pulls off impossible comeback: down 8-0 with one out left, wins 10-9
story_log.development: Texas Tech was down 8-0 with only one out remaining in NCAA tournament game. Hit grand slam to tie it, then won 10-9 in extras. Teams were 0-640 this century when trailing by 8+ runs in tourney.

story_log.title: NBA accidentally runs Cavs-Knicks ECF promo before Cavs-Pistons Game 7
story_log.development: ABC ran a Cavaliers vs Knicks Eastern Conference Finals ad this morning while Cavs are still playing Pistons in second round Game 7. Internet jokes about 'scriptwriters' leaking the result.

story_log.title: Julio Rodríguez robs home run with epic leaping grab
story_log.development: Julio made spectacular leaping catch at wall to rob homer vs Padres. Mariners lost 7-4 but Julio put on a show.

story_log.title: Rodolfo Durán gets first career hit and homer after 11 years in minors
story_log.development: Durán spent 11 years in minor leagues before recording his first MLB hit, which was a home run. Emotional moment.

story_log.title: Zack Wheeler vs Paul Skenes is Sunday's must-watch pitching matchup
story_log.development: Phillies ace Wheeler faces Pirates phenom Skenes on Sunday. TalkinBaseball_ hyping it as 'amazing pitching matchup.'

story_log.title: Aroldis Chapman makes hell of a play to end game for White Sox
story_log.development: Chapman, now closing for Chicago, made defensive gem to seal Sox win. Sox on 5-game win streak.

story_log.title: Spurs eliminate Timberwolves, advance to WCF to face Thunder
story_log.development: Spurs won Game 6 in Minnesota 139-109 to close out series 4-2. Stephon Castle exploded for 32-11-6 with 5 threes. Anthony Edwards dapped up Spurs bench with 8 minutes left. Julius Randle and Rudy Gobert combined for 3 points on 1-12 FG. Spurs face defending champs OKC in WCF.

story_log.title: Pistons force Game 7 behind BBall Paul, Cade, and Duren's dominance
story_log.development: Detroit won Game 6 in Cleveland 115-94 to force Game 7 back in Detroit. Paul Reed was everywhere, Jalen Duren played with force, Cade Cunningham orchestrated. Donovan Mitchell held scoreless in Game 6 struggles. Winner goes to Eastern Conference Finals vs Knicks.

story_log.title: Mets' Clay Holmes fractures fibula on 111 mph comebacker, out long time
story_log.development: Holmes fractured fibula after taking 111 mph comebacker to leg in Subway Series. Initially stayed in game. Team says he'll be out 'a long time.' Holmes leads Mets in WAR this season.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber reaches 20 homers before Fernando Tatis Jr. hits ONE
story_log.development: Schwarber became first player to 20 homers this season. Tatis still has zero. Schwarber can't explain why he's on this tear. Internet notices the absurdity.

story_log.title: 2026 NFL schedule criticized for historic rest disparity
story_log.development: Sharp Football Analysis published full rest disparity breakdown: 110 games with rest advantage (most ever), Chargers get -24 net rest (worst since 2013), Bears get +15 (2nd-best since 1990). League prioritized money over competitive fairness.

story_log.title: Golden Knights stripped of 2nd-round pick, Tortorella fined $100k for media violations
story_log.development: NHL stripped Vegas of second-round pick and fined coach John Tortorella $100k for 'flagrant violations' of Stanley Cup playoff media regulations. Unprecedented penalty.

story_log.title: Charles Woodson Jr. commits to Michigan, following father's legendary footsteps
story_log.development: Four-star DB Charles Woodson Jr. committed to Michigan, same school where his father won Heisman Trophy. Like father, like son.

story_log.title: Suspect arrested in shooting of Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy
story_log.development: 20-year-old man arrested in connection with shooting of Missouri star Ahmad Hardy at outdoor concert in Mississippi. Hardy remains in stable condition.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson becomes first player in WNBA history with multiple 45-point games
story_log.development: Wilson dropped 45+ points for second time in career, only player in WNBA history to do it multiple times. Aces beat Sun.

story_log.title: Mason Miller pitching like the best closer in baseball
story_log.development: Miller threw 34-pitch, 4-out save with 4 strikeouts. Now has 21 IP, 0.86 ERA, 44 SO, 14 SV, leads all relievers in K/9 (18.86). A's have an absolute weapon.

story_log.title: Wolves traded more picks for Rudy Gobert than he scored in Games 5 and 6 combined
story_log.development: StatMuse tweet roasting Gobert: Wolves gave up more draft picks for him than his combined point total in final two games of series. Gobert had 0 points in Game 6.

story_log.title: Stephon Castle becomes youngest player ever with 30-10-5-5 playoff game
story_log.development: Castle at 21 became youngest player in NBA history with 30+ pts, 10+ reb, 5+ ast, 5+ threes in a playoff game. Historic performance to close out Wolves.

story_log.title: Wemby on facing OKC: 'I'm thinking about getting this press conference over with'
story_log.development: Wemby postgame when asked about facing Thunder: 'Right now I'm not even thinking about it. I'm thinking about recovering. I'm thinking about getting this press conference over with.' Internet loves the exhausted honesty.

story_log.title: Canadiens can close out Sabres in Game 6 at home
story_log.development: Montreal leads series 3-2, can advance to Conference Finals at home tonight. Cole Caufield has 21 goals in 23 Saturday games this season including playoffs, leads NHL.

story_log.title: Cooper Flagg and girlfriend already have people talking about 'Class of 2045' kids
story_log.development: Flagg dating Arianna Robertson (sister of Andre Roberson, also at Duke). Internet already projecting their future kids as basketball prospects: 'Their kids will be 6'1 by 3rd grade.' Wholesome, absurd, very internet.

story_log.title: 2026 NFL schedule release: videos, strength of schedule, primetime games, international slate
story_log.development: Full 2026 NFL schedule released tonight with teams posting creative schedule release videos. Analysis includes strength of schedule breakdowns, primetime slates, bye weeks, road schedules, and strategic advantages/disadvantages across all 32 teams.

story_log.title: Canadiens take 3-2 series lead after wild 6-3 Game 5 win over Sabres
story_log.development: Montreal rallied from 3-1 down to win Game 5 in Buffalo with 5 goals in first 10:15 of game. Ivan Demidov scored first career playoff goal, Jakub Dobes made 32 saves. Canadiens one win from Conference Finals.

story_log.title: Golden Knights close out Ducks in 6 games, advance to Western Conference Finals
story_log.development: Vegas won Game 6 in Anaheim 5-1 to clinch series 4-2 and advance to WCF. Mitch Marner had hat trick and assist. Knights reach Conference Finals for third time in franchise history.

story_log.title: Drake drops THREE albums at midnight: ICEMAN, HABIBTI, MAID OF HONOUR
story_log.development: Drake surprised everyone by releasing three full albums at midnight (titles spell HIM). Featured Future reunion track. Crashed Apple Music and Spotify servers. Included shots at Bronny James and other NBA targets.

story_log.title: Myles Turner reveals Doc Rivers refused to fine Bucks players for tardiness, meetings
story_log.development: Turner on podcast disclosed that Doc Rivers didn't fine anyone for being late to team functions, leading to widespread tardiness and missed meetings. Said Giannis would show up whenever he wanted.

story_log.title: White Sox complete sweep of Royals, MLB-best 5-game win streak
story_log.development: Chicago completes sweep of Kansas City to push win streak to 5 games, best active streak in baseball. Remarkable turnaround for struggling franchise.

story_log.title: Cubs shut out Braves 2-0 behind Ian Happ homer — first XBH in 21 innings
story_log.development: Ian Happ hit 10th homer of year to break Cubs' 21-inning drought without an extra-base hit. Chicago beat Atlanta 2-0, Ben Brown solid on mound.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber crushes 2-run homer in 8th to give Phillies lead over Red Sox
story_log.development: Schwarber broke scoreless tie in eighth inning with 2-run shot. Phillies beat Red Sox 3-1 as Ranger Suarez and Chris Sale dueled.

story_log.title: Dalton Rushing breaks bat over knee, hits himself in helmet with another bat in dugout rage
story_log.development: Dodgers catcher snapped bat over knee in frustration, then accidentally hit himself in helmet while breaking second bat. Later made sure umpire was okay after foul ball.

story_log.title: Will Smith homers in first-ever leadoff appearance for Dodgers
story_log.development: Dodgers catcher batted leadoff for first time in career and immediately went deep against Giants.

story_log.title: Lynx beat Wings 90-86 as Olivia Miles outplays Azzi Fudd in battle of top-2 picks
story_log.development: First WNBA matchup between No. 1 pick Miles (15-6 ast) and No. 2 pick Fudd (8 pts). Minnesota gets win over Dallas.

story_log.title: Bulls hire Magic's Stephen Mervis as SVP, Nets' Acie Law as VP under Bryson Graham
story_log.development: Chicago finalizing deal to bring in Mervis (12 years with Magic) as Senior VP of Basketball Ops and Law (former Thunder/Kings scout) as VP of Player Personnel under new EVP Graham.

story_log.title: Oilers fire head coach Kris Knoblauch despite extension signed in October
story_log.development: Edmonton dismissed Knoblauch who had signed 3-year extension last October that was set to begin in 2026-27 season.

story_log.title: Scottie Scheffler, Jordan Spieth share first-round lead at PGA Championship
story_log.development: Scheffler and Spieth tied for lead after Round 1 at Aronimink. Scheffler's first career major first-round lead. Rory McIlroy melts down with 4 straight bogeys. Bryson struggles. Garrick Higgo penalized 2 strokes for being late to tee time.

story_log.title: Cavs finally win on the road, take 3-2 series lead over Pistons in OT thriller
story_log.development: Cleveland gets their first road win of the playoffs (was 0-5) in overtime Game 5 thriller in Detroit. Harden 30-8-6-3b, Max Strus 20 pts/6 threes. Cade had 39-9-7 in loss. Series shifts back to Cleveland for Game 6.

story_log.title: Avalanche rally from 3-0 down, advance to Western Conference Finals in OT
story_log.development: Colorado trailed 3-0 midway through second period, tied it late in regulation, then Brett Kulak won it in OT. MacKinnon scored in his 6th straight game. Avs reach Conference Finals for first time since winning Cup in 2022.

story_log.title: Dolphins make De'Von Achane third-highest-paid RB with $64M extension
story_log.development: Miami and Achane agreed to 4-year, $64M extension ($68M with incentives), $32M guaranteed. Makes him third-highest-paid RB. Comes days after Jets gave Breece Hall 3-year, $45.5M deal.

story_log.title: Ohtani dominates on mound again while slumping at plate: 7 IP, 8 K, 0 ER
story_log.development: Ohtani struck out 8 in 7 scoreless innings vs Giants, continuing mound dominance. But he's out of lineup again due to slump at plate. His ERA now 0.82, lowest among qualified pitchers.

story_log.title: NBA lands on '3-2-1 lottery' proposal to curb tanking
story_log.development: Adam Silver confirmed on Stephen A. Smith's show that NBA has landed on proposal to present to board of governors later this month to revamp draft lottery.

story_log.title: Braves become first MLB team to 30 wins with comeback over Cubs
story_log.development: Atlanta rallied with 3 runs in 8th inning to beat Cubs 4-1, improving to 30-13, first team to reach 30 wins.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark's first two games: 20/5/7 and 24/4/9 in 2-0 Fever start
story_log.development: Clark followed opening night's 20-5-7 with 24-4-9 tonight. Fever are 2-0 to start season. Magic Johnson was courtside watching.

story_log.title: Rockies' Mickey Moniak hits for the cycle vs Pirates
story_log.development: Moniak went double-triple-homer and then singled to complete cycle. First Rockies cycle since Charlie Blackmon in 2018.

story_log.title: Jacob Misiorowski now leads MLB with 80 strikeouts after 7 more shutout innings
story_log.development: Misiorowski threw 7 shutout innings with more strikeouts, now leads all of MLB with 80 Ks. Dylan Cease is second with 75.

story_log.title: Daulton Varsho hits walk-off grand slam for Blue Jays
story_log.development: Varsho hit walk-off grand slam to give Toronto dramatic win.

story_log.title: Yankees' Max Fried exits start with elbow soreness, will undergo testing
story_log.development: Fried pulled after 3 innings with soreness in pitching elbow. Says he's 'not too worried' but will undergo tests Thursday.

story_log.title: Juan Soto exits game after fouling ball off foot, X-rays negative
story_log.development: Soto fouled ball off right foot early in game, was shaken up, later removed in 7th inning. X-rays came back negative, listed day-to-day.

story_log.title: Rockies OF Jake McCarthy turns first unassisted DP by outfielder since 2015
story_log.development: McCarthy recorded rare unassisted double play from outfield vs Pirates, first by OF since 2015.

story_log.title: NFL announces first Thanksgiving Eve game: Packers at Rams on Netflix
story_log.development: Packers-Rams will be first-ever Thanksgiving Eve NFL game on Wednesday night before Thanksgiving, on Netflix. Part of expanding Netflix NFL package.
